claim.claim-text: 1. Decorative or functional layer (2.1), with different degrees of gloss applicable extending at least partially covering a substrate (1) and said layer (2.1) being in correspondence with a relief obtained (7) on the substrate (1).
2. Decorative or functional layer (2.1) according to previous claim, wherein said layer (2.1) is applied in a coordinated manner with the relief (7) on an image (2.2) applied on the substrate (1).
3. Decorative or functional layer (2.1) according to one of claims 1 or 2, wherein the relief obtained (7) on the substrate (1) is transparent.
4. Decorative or functional layer according to one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the relief (7) of the substrate (1) is obtained by sublimation of a relief product applied on the substrate (1).
